exposure: patient age group (<= 18 years vs > 18 years)
outcome: type of surgery (e.g., neurosurgery, orthopedic, urological, dermatological/plastic)
percentage change in surgery types between age groups
cohort: The study included 556 Japanese patients with myelomeningocele from health claims data.
finding: A significant number of surgeries across multiple specialties related to myelomeningocele continue to be performed into adulthood, demonstrating a need for continuous lifelong care.
